component.name: Game of Life
component.summary: Conway's Game of Life and other Life-like cellular automata

description.p: A native desktop implementation of Conway's Game of Life, built with egui/eframe. Includes 22 built-in Life-like rules grouped by long-term behavior (stable/chaotic/explosive), a 35-pattern library (still lifes, oscillators, spaceships, guns, methuselahs), density-based starting configurations, a Draw/Pan/Eraser toolbox, Google Maps-style pan and zoom, and a minimap.
